one_liner: HubSpot has a broad REST API with self-serve OAuth2 apps, free developer accounts, service keys/private tokens, and an official remote MCP server at mcp.hubspot.com.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow for public apps (multi-account distribution requires OAuth). Static tokens: service keys, private/static app access tokens (Bearer) for single-account use. The remote MCP server uses OAuth with PKCE via an MCP connector.
access_notes: Free developer account with API access for development and testing; apps can be built without a paid subscription. Installing apps requires Super Admin in the target account (not verified in the supplied pages).
blocker_notes: No blocker; free developer account allows building and testing.
